name: db3-dock
description: Local process manager for db3 apps: runs each project's npm scripts with live terminals.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGINT --success first --names server,client,electron --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev" "node scripts/electron-dev.mjs"
scripts.start: npm run build && node --import tsx server/index.ts
